text:
jo (DevEx): onboarding blocked: samplekit publish failed due to typegen bumping the generated package version after regendiff. @vic @maya can you take a look?
vic (Eng): on it. paste of regendiff?
jo (DevEx): regendiff excerpt:
```
--- a/openapi.yaml
+++ b/openapi.yaml
@@
-    description: "Sample event. // legacy note"
+    description: "Sample event. // clarified"
@@
-  - session_id
+  - sessionId
```
maya (SDK): thanks. this is non-functional: small comment tweak and example field casing changed. codegen reordered properties and typegen generated a changelog entry, which bumped semver 4.2.1 -> 4.3.0. reproducible with: `./dev/regendiff packages/samplekit --base main`
release-bot: [publish] blocked on refs/heads/onboard/samplekit  reason: semver-check mismatch (4.2.1 -> 4.3.0)
vic (Eng): short-term fix: pin the generated package version in packages/samplekit/package.json back to 4.2.1 and add a regen-lint CI step that fails early so new hires hit this sooner. i'll open a hotfix PR.
maya (SDK): long-term: update typegen to ignore comment-only/whitespace-only hunks before producing changelog entries and make property/enum ordering deterministic (sort stable by name + original index). i've a draft PR for the changelog normalization.
jo (DevEx): can we also add a tiny onboarding note so L4+ mentors know the workaround? this keeps new hire flows smooth.
vic (Eng): yep PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/501 (pin gen-version + regen-lint). merging after CI green.
maya (SDK): linking draft mitigation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/318 (strip-comment-diffs + deterministic-ordering). tests included.
jo (DevEx): thanks both. i'll rerun onboarding once merged and add a one-line note to the onboarding checklist.
